rationale: While price is fading hard from the open (sitting at 5.8% of today's range, near the low) after a massive prior-day move, the 74-bps bid-ask spread creates a structural headwind that materially erodes any edge on a small intraday move. Without EMAs or ATR available to quantify momentum or volatility-based targets, and with no news catalyst to explain the elevated relative volume (12.13x), the mechanical edge is too uncertain to justify risking capital in either direction.
